role: Bulk of WorkoutNamespace's catalog (extension): live route topology/weather/recognized-route facts, hrv.peak.* and hrv.window.* overnight facts, user.profile FTP facts, workout feeling/segment-compare/most-recent snapshot/deep-dive/streak facts, the workout.timeline downsampler and SegmentPointSampler shared with the live segment lookback.
types: WorkoutNamespace: extension — detail FactEntry declarations and resolvers
SegmentPointSampler: enum — nearest-GPS-fix + per-second sample matcher
toplevel: Static AI-facing description strings and SegmentPointSampler's constants.

units.does: Flattens the six detail entry groups (live, hrv peak, hrv window, user profile, feeling/segment/snapshot, streak) into one list.
Returns live route topology, weather and recognized-route entries.
Returns hrv.peak total power and RMSSD entries.
Returns hrv.window classification / organized / consolidated entries.
Returns user.profile running and cycling FTP entries.
Returns feeling, feeling note, segment compare, most-recent snapshot and deep-dive entries.
Returns streak consecutive-days and this-week-count entries.
Declares fixed fact `workout.live.route_topology` resolved by resolveWorkoutLiveRouteTopology.
Reads the live workout snapshot and returns its bound route topology as a record.

branches.effect: false: missing(.notYetComputed,'no route bound'); true: record

units.does: Builds topology record: climbs_ahead, turns_ahead lists, ascent remaining, peak altitude, altitude above route min, meters to peak, optional steepest grade.
Builds one climb record: distance to start, grade, plus length/gain when > 0 and road_name when non-empty.
Builds one turn record: distance, signed bearing change, direction label.
Declares fixed fact `workout.live.weather` resolved by resolveWorkoutLiveWeather.
Returns the live snapshot's weather (temp, wind speed/direction, humidity, conditions, observed_at, optional apparent temp).

branches.effect: false: missing(.notYetComputed,'weather fetch hasn't returned yet')

units.does: Declares fixed fact `workout.live.recognized_route` resolved by resolveWorkoutLiveRecognizedRoute; description lists the statuses, sport_not_supported included.
Returns the matched route record when the live snapshot has a recognized route name; else unsupportedSportRecord when recognition never runs for the sport; else the diagnostic unmatched record.

Reads RouteLibrary.supportedSports' display names on the main actor (assumeIsolated); when the snapshot's sport (a display name) is not among them returns {status: 'sport_not_supported', sport, detail naming the supported sports}, else nil.
Builds {status:'matched', name, auto_detected, direction?, total_distance_meters?, climbs_ahead_total?}.

Reads RouteLibrary.detectionTriggerMeters (500) and SavedRouteStore.routes.count on MainActor, classifies recognizer status and returns a diagnostic record with covered/trigger meters and detail text.
Maps (savedCount, covered, trigger) to status no_saved_routes / awaiting_distance / no_match with English detail text.

branches.effect: status awaiting_distance with remaining meters; else no_match citing 30 m tolerance (hard-coded text, matches RouteLibrary.matchToleranceMeters)

units.does: Declares fixed fact `hrv.peak.total_power_ms2`: peakCapacity.peakTotalPower of OvernightArchive.latest; description says that is last night's reading or, on a day with no reliable overnight, the nap or quick reading hrv.latest reports.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: Double?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

branches.effect: false: missing(.notRecorded,'no overnight session'); true: .from(peakTotalPower) or missing 'peak-capacity analysis not present'

units.does: Declares fixed fact `hrv.peak.rmssd_ms`: peakCapacity.peakRMSSD of OvernightArchive.latest (last night's reading, or the nap/quick reading hrv.latest reports on a day without a reliable overnight).
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: Double?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

units.does: Declares fixed fact `hrv.window.classification`: analysisResult.windowClassification string.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: String?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

units.does: Declares fixed fact `hrv.window.is_organized_recovery`: analysisResult.isOrganizedRecovery.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: Bool?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

units.does: Declares fixed fact `hrv.window.is_consolidated`: analysisResult.isConsolidated.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: Bool?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

units.does: Declares fixed fact `user.profile.running_ftp`: settings.effectiveRunningFTP (user value or FTPAutoEstimator cache) read on MainActor.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: Int?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

units.does: Declares fixed fact `user.profile.cycling_ftp`: settingsSnapshot.effectiveCyclingFTP (user value only).
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: Int?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

units.does: Declares `workout.feeling.by_date($date)` returning workoutFeeling 1-5.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: Int?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

branches.effect: false: returns noWorkout(on:) — invalidParameter for a malformed date, internalError when the day's workout is indexed but unreadable, else notRecorded 'no workout on X'; true: .from(feeling,'user has not rated this workout')

units.does: Declares `workout.feeling_note.by_date($date)` returning workoutFeelingNote text.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift::func FactValue.from(_: String?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)

branches.effect: false: returns noWorkout(on:) — invalidParameter for a malformed date, internalError when the day's workout is indexed but unreadable, else notRecorded 'no workout on X'; true: .from(note,'user has not attached a note')

units.does: Declares `workout.segment_compare($params)` resolved by resolveWorkoutSegmentCompareParams.
Parses 'lat,lon[,radius_m]' (radius 5..5000, default 50), finds past workouts passing within radius and returns their per-point records.

branches.effect: true: missing(.notRecorded,'no past workouts passed within Nm'); false: list

units.does: Returns SegmentPointSampler.matches over the archive: past workouts among the 30 newest GPS-bearing ones that pass within radius.
Declares fixed fact `workout.most_recent.snapshot`: deepDiveRecord of the newest workout.

branches.effect: missing(.internalError,'… couldn't be read'); otherwise deep-dive record

units.does: Declares `workout.deep_dive.by_date($date)`: deepDiveRecord for the newest workout on that date.

branches.effect: false: returns noWorkout(on:) — invalidParameter for a malformed date, internalError when the day's workout is indexed but unreadable, else notRecorded 'no workout on X'; true: record

units.does: Declares fixed fact `workout.streak.consecutive_days` returning consecutiveWorkoutDays.
Counts consecutive local days ending today that have at least one workout entry.

branches.effect: true: streak+1 and step back a day; false: stop

units.does: Declares fixed fact `workout.streak.this_week_count`: workouts dated from the locale week start through now.
Returns [workoutTimelineByDateDateEntry].
Declares `workout.timeline.by_date($date)`: downsampled per-second timeline for the newest workout on that date.

branches.effect: false: returns noWorkout(on:) — invalidParameter for a malformed date, internalError when the day's workout is indexed but unreadable, else notRecorded 'no workout on X'
false: missing(.notRecorded,'no per-second sample stream'); true: timelineRecord

units.does: Sorts samples, sets bucketSec = ceil(lastOffset/200) (min 1), takes the per-bucket median records from timelineBuckets (at most 200 buckets) and returns envelope {date, duration_sec, bucket_sec, bucket_count, buckets, sport?}.

Groups the (sorted) samples by offset/bucketSec, clamped to bucket maxBuckets-1 so the final offset never opens an extra bucket, and returns one bucketRecord (medians keyed by the bucket's start offset) per non-empty bucket in time order.

branches.effect: always true for existing keys; else dropped

units.does: Builds one bucket record: offset_sec plus medians of HR (rounded int), pace, cadence, altitude, alpha1, power (rounded int) and bucket grade when available.

branches.cond: power median exists (nil for no power samples)

units.does: Grade % = (last alt - first alt)/(last dist - first dist)×100 when both ends have altitude and distance and ≥5 m covered.

branches.cond: first/last altitude and distance present and Δdistance ≥ 5

units.does: Median of a Double array (mean of middle two for even count); nil when empty.

branches.effect: average of two middle values; odd: middle value

units.does: Walks the archive's workouts that `include` accepts, newest first and at most the newest 120, lightweight-loading each until 30 with a GPS polyline have been read; returns SegmentPointSampler.match for each of those that passes within radius.
calls: closure:include — caller filter (the live lookup drops the in-flight session)

branches.cond: for each of the newest 120 accepted workouts while fewer than 30 GPS tracks read
session fails to load or has no gpsPolyline

units.does: Decodes a session's GPS polyline into a track, finds nearest fix to target; if within radius returns record {date, sport rawValue, offset_sec_at_point, distance_to_point_m, pace_sec_per_km_at_point?, sample fields}.
Adds HR/power/cadence/altitude/alpha1 from the sample nearest offsetSec when within ±10 s.
Full scan returning the sample whose offsetSec is closest to the target.
